description: Source code for a MAC address manipulation utility, including functions for parsing, printing, and performing logical operations on MAC addresses, as well as command-line interface handling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses command-line arguments and dispatches to specific MAC address operations.

methods.name: parse_mac
methods.description: Parses a MAC address string into a byte buffer.

methods.name: print_mac
methods.description: Prints a MAC address from a byte buffer.

methods.name: maccalc_do_add
methods.description: Adds a number to the MAC address's last three bytes.

methods.name: maccalc_do_logical
methods.description: Performs a logical operation (AND, OR, XOR) on two MAC addresses.

methods.name: maccalc_do_mac2bin
methods.description: Outputs the MAC address as binary data to stdout.

methods.name: maccalc_do_bin2mac
methods.description: Reads binary MAC address data from stdin and prints it.

methods.name: maccalc_do_or
methods.description: Performs bitwise OR on two MAC addresses.

methods.name: maccalc_do_and
methods.description: Performs bitwise AND on two MAC addresses.

methods.name: maccalc_do_xor
methods.description: Performs bitwise XOR on two MAC addresses.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the utility.
